system.description: Once reserved for the personal guard of high-level Mandate functionaries. Has all the functionality of an assault suit, increases the wearer's effective Strength to 18, and grants a bonus Main Action in the first round of combat. Requires the same Type B energy cell as an assault suit. Renders the wearer immune to harm from unarmed attacks, grenades, or weapons of TL3 or lower. Obvious. Sealed-suit armor, unusable by wearers without a basically human body plan. Not normally available for sale.
